fits_lines.why: The shot is a simple, clean, and generic wide shot of the dealer at his petrol pump. It establishes the setting and the character's role. It can be used flexibly under various voiceover lines.

S11-app.setting: Two men standing outside a modern office building with large glass windows.

timeline.action: The dealer stands beside a younger man, looking down at a smartphone the other man is holding. He smiles and points at the screen with his right index finger, which moves slightly as if tapping or scrolling.
He lifts his head to look at the younger man's face. His smile widens and his mouth moves slightly as if he is speaking to him, while his right hand remains pointing towards the phone.

calm_windows.what: The entire shot shows a natural interaction between two men looking at a phone. The dealer points at the screen and then looks up to speak to his companion.

fits_lines.why: The visual of two men engaged with a phone supports the theme of a digital service (Dealer Kavach) and communication ('reply to the person').
The action of using a phone directly corresponds to the narrator's instructions to send questions, recordings, or photos via a device.
The action perfectly illustrates the line about installing or using an app on a phone. The dealer pointing and then looking up to talk looks like a demonstration or explanation.
